places: government offices in the Yaren District

fields.climate: tropical with a monsoonal pattern; rainy season (November to February)
fields.terrain: sandy beach rises to fertile ring around raised coral reefs with phosphate plateau in center
fields.farm: coconuts, tropical fruits, pork, eggs, pork offal, pork fat, chicken, papayas, vegetables, cabbages
fields.industries: phosphate mining, offshore banking, coconut products
fields.languages: Nauruan 93% (official, a distinct Pacific Island language), English 2% (widely understood, spoken, and used for most government and commercial purposes), other 5% (includes Gilbertese 2% and Chinese…
fields.religions: Protestant 60.4% (Nauruan Congregational 34.7%, Assemblies of God 11.6%, Pacific Light House 6.3%, Nauru Independent 3.6%, Baptist 1.5, Seventh Day Adventist 1.3%, other Protestant 1.4%), Roman…

independence.from: Australia-, NZ-, and UK-administered UN trusteeship

fields.legal: mixed system of common law based on the English model and customary law
fields.suffrage: 20 years of age; universal and compulsory
